questions.question:
Arrange the given words in alphabetical order:

1. EXOTIC

2. EXEMPLIFY

3. EXERCISE

4. EXHAUST

5. EXCHANGE
questions.solution:
The correct Dictionary order is:

5. EX__**CH**__ANGE

2. EX__**EM**__PLIFY

3. EX__**ER**__CISE

4. EX__**H**__AUST

1. EX**__O__**TIC

So, the correct order are: '**5, 2, 3, 4, 1**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

ccdde _ ffggcc _ deeffggccdd _ eff _ g
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: ccdde _ ffggcc _ deeffggccdd _ eff _ g

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) efgh → ccdde__e__ffgg / cc__f__deeffgg / ccdd__g__eff__h__g

Option 2) **edeg →** ccdde__**e**__ffgg / cc__**d**__deeffgg / ccdd__**e**__eff__**g**__g

Here, 'ccddeeffgg' followed a pattern.

Option 3) efcg → ccdde__e__ffgg / cc__f__deeffgg / ccdd__c__eff__g__g

Option 4) cdeg → ccdde__c__ffgg / cc__d__deeffgg / ccdd__e__eff__g__g

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). A is second to the left of D. D is third to the left of E. C is third to the right of G. G is not the immediate neighbour of E. H is third to the right of B. B is second to the right of G. Who is sitting on the immediate left of E?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) A is second to the left of D.

2) D is third to the left of E.

3) C is third to the right of G.

4) G is not the immediate neighbour of E.

5) H is third to the right of B.

6) B is second to the right of G.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b69dc73355a1cc66d040f53dad06a85d6dfeef3886d52441ddf4fac34a381944.png] 

So, **C** is sitting on the immediate left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion (s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All C are V.

II. No C is B.

**Conclusions:**

I. All V are C.

II. All B are V.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. All C are V.

II. No C is B.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/763cc0193bc81b3f7f7082b39bac45715dcca5235fa1926169ebe27905dc7a0c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All V are C. - **False **(Because, All C are V, some B can be C but all V can not C)

II. All B are V. - False (Because, No C is B and All C are V, so, All B can not V it is not definite)

So, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion follows".**

How is S related to l in the expression 'S + H × I + J'?

Family Chart:

 ×

Given: S + H × I + J

It means: S is the brother of H, H is the wife of I and I is the brother of J.

So, S is the **'Wife's brother**' of I.
